dialogues.jp: 「ぐぅぅ……ようやく終わったか」
ぐっと伸びをして、気分をほぐす。
dialogues.en: I lean back in my seat and stretch.
dialogues.text: I lean back in my seat and stretch.

dialogues.jp:
周りを見ると、｛さすが／流石｝に教科書を開きながら弁当
を食べているやつが多い。
dialogues.en:
All around me, I could see several of my classmates eating
lunch and studying in the classroom at the same time.
dialogues.text:
All around me, I could see several of my classmates eating
lunch and studying in the classroom at the same time.

dialogues.jp:
さすがに試験前ともなると、教科書開きながら
弁当食べているやつが多い。
dialogues.en:
As expected as the exams drew closer, plenty of people were
now studying and eating at the same time.
dialogues.text:
As expected as the exams drew closer, plenty of people were
now studying and eating at the same time.

dialogues.jp: さて、俺はどうするかな。
dialogues.en: Now then, what should I do.
dialogues.text: Now then, what should I do.
